import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
r1 = int(input[1])
r2 = int(input[2])
p = list(map(int, input[3:]))

parent = {i + 1: int(p[i]) for i in range(n - 1)}
path_to_r2 = []
current = r2
while current != r1:
    path_to_r2.append(current)
    current = parent[current]
path_to_r2.append(r1)

for city in path_to_r2:
    parent[city] = path_to_r2[-1]

result = [str(parent[i]) for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != r1]
print(' '.join(result))
